_comment: Configuration for scripts/cobol_lint.py. Every rule must appear under 'rules'. 'reason' fields document why a threshold or exemption exists; docs/linting.md explains each rule.
tab_width_reason: CUSTREC.cpy was written with 4-column tabs; CBSTM03A (which copies it) only compiles with -ftab-width=4. Used by the cobc check and by `fix` when expanding tabs.

paths.generated_reason: cpy-bms members are symbolic maps generated from the BMS sources in bms/; their repetition is produced by the BMS assembler, so duplicate-block skips them.

external_copybooks.reason: Supplied by CICS (DFH*), IBM MQ (CMQ*) and the DB2 precompiler (SQLCA/SQLDA) at compile time on the mainframe; they are not part of this repository.

syntax.reason: GnuCOBOL has no CICS, DB2 or IMS precompiler, so programs containing EXEC CICS/SQL/DLI are listed as skipped instead of compiled. -std=ibm matches the Enterprise COBOL dialect; copybook paths are the program's own module plus the base app.

trailing-whitespace.reason: Most sources are stored as fixed 80-byte records padded with blanks (scripts/pad.awk produces them). A line padded to exactly record_length is that convention, not stray whitespace; any other trailing whitespace is reported.

text-past-column-72.reason: Columns 73-80 normally carry an 8-character sequence or change tag such as 00010000; only other content (text running past column 72, shifted sequence numbers) is reported. Comment lines are skipped.

copybook-prefix.reason: CV = file/record layouts, CS = shared services and utilities, CO = online screens, commarea and menus, CU = legacy customer layout, CC/CI = authorization request and IMS segment layouts, DCL = DCLGEN table declarations, *PCB = IMS PCB masks, IMSFUNCS = IMS function-code constants.

sensitive-display.reason: Patterns cover the PII, card and credential fields in CVCUS01Y/CUSTREC, CVACT02Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y/06Y, CSUSR01Y, CVEXPORT and the authorization IMS/MQ layouts (CIPAUDTY, CCPAURQY, CCPAURLY). A group item containing a matching field is sensitive too.
